title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-23
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains, corroborated against primary repository pages and current default-branch commits; signal score used as a secondary tie/context signal.
ranking_explanation: The 12 selected non-fork, non-archived repositories are ordered by stars_gained from the supplied daily signal file. The signal's score and its components are retained as additional context, not substituted for daily star gains. All selected repositories had days_trending_30d=3. Zero score was not used as an exclusion criterion.
global_caveat: The signal collector could not authenticate with GitHub CLI for star snapshots, so delta_1d, delta_7d, and delta_30d are null/unavailable for every candidate. Null does not mean zero. Daily Trending totals can differ slightly from later REST totals. The signal is attention, not evidence of product quality or adoption.

sources.corroboration: GitHub REST API repository records and default-branch commits at https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}; primary README content at https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/readme
sources.star_snapshot_status: unavailable: GitHub CLI was not authenticated; all candidate delta_1d, delta_7d, and delta_30d values are null

themes.title: Agent skills and repeatable workflows
themes.content: Domain-specific skills and structured methods package security, software development, research, and compliance work for coding agents.

themes.title: Agent-native interfaces and operations
themes.content: Software-to-CLI bridging, web data access, and CI failure investigation connect agents to tools and operational work.

themes.title: AI-assisted media and creative output
themes.content: Automated short-video production and branded diagram generation apply agents to concrete creative deliverables.

themes.title: Accessible LLM learning
themes.content: Small-scale model training and a fully inspectable training path lower barriers to hands-on LLM education.

themes.title: Privacy-first productivity software
themes.content: A local-first workspace combining documents, canvas, and planning provides a non-agent-centric product counterpoint.

themes.title: General-purpose download tooling
themes.content: A cross-platform downloader is a high-gain consumer utility outside the agent-centered cluster.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: The sharpest signal is the spread of agent-oriented software: security skills, development workflows, software-to-CLI bridges, and CI repair agents all feature among the leaders. AI-enabled media and research workflows also drew substantial attention, while MiniMind shows continued interest in accessible, end-to-end LLM training.

sections.title: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
sections.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and authorized external red-team work, with vulnerability-class playbooks and disclosed-report patterns.
sections.why_notable: Highest daily gain (+2,037) and signal score (9.12); primary README describes a sizeable, structured security skill bundle.

sections.title: XiaoYouChR/Ghost-Downloader-3
sections.description: A cross-platform downloader project with a broad feature set.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain (+1,078) and score (8.484); the repository README presents it as a general-purpose downloader.
sections.unique_caveat: The README is primarily Chinese, with English also available.

sections.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
sections.description: Website search and extraction infrastructure that turns web content into agent-ready data.
sections.why_notable: Third-highest daily gain (+920; score 8.325); README documents local/self-hosted and hosted modes plus SDKs.

sections.title: zhouxiaoka/autoclip
sections.description: An open-source desktop, CLI, and MCP tool that turns long-form videos into short clips and publishing assets.
sections.why_notable: Fourth-highest daily gain (+908; score 8.312); README describes a multi-platform flow from source link to edited video, cover, and publishing copy.
sections.unique_caveat: The project says its software is free while cloud models are usage-billed.

sections.title: obra/superpowers
sections.description: A composable skills framework and software-development methodology for coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Strong daily gain (+838; score 8.232) for an established project; README emphasizes spec-first planning, test-driven development, and subagent-driven implementation.

sections.title: jingyaogong/minimind
sections.description: A tutorial and implementation for training small language models from scratch.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +828 (score 8.22); README lays out a learning path spanning pretraining, fine-tuning, preference optimization, and tool use, with lightweight models as the entry point.

sections.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
sections.description: An agent skill that researches topics across social, video, news, and web sources, then synthesizes findings.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +790 (score 8.173) signals demand for source-aggregating research workflows; README describes a multi-source agent-led pipeline and multiple skills hosts.

sections.title: HKUDS/CLI-Anything
sections.description: A project for making desktop and other software operable by agents through generated command-line interfaces.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +783 (score 8.164) makes agent-native interfaces a major theme; README shows generated CLI workflows across creative and technical applications.

sections.title: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
sections.description: A reference playbook and pre-submission checks for Apple App Store and Google Play requirements.
sections.why_notable: High daily gain relative to its smaller base (+755; score 8.128); README is explicit that scans cannot guarantee approval and some checks need human judgment.
sections.unique_caveat: Automated checks cannot guarantee approval; the README says some checks need human judgment.

sections.title: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
sections.description: An agent skill for creating branded diagrams as self-contained HTML and SVG.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +624 (score 7.938) reflects interest in polished agent outputs; README describes 52 diagram types and import/export workflows.

sections.title: toeverything/AFFiNE
sections.description: A local-first workspace combining documents, canvas, and planning.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +593 (score 7.887); primary README positions it as a privacy-focused Notion/Miro alternative with merged docs, canvas, and tables.

sections.title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre
sections.description: A self-hosted CLI agent that investigates failed CI runs and proposes fixes for review.
sections.why_notable: Daily gain of +438 (score 7.584) adds an operational, reviewable agent workflow; README labels the project public alpha.
sections.unique_caveat: README labels the project public alpha.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent skills and repeatable workflows are represented by Claude-BugHunter, Superpowers, last30days-skill, and app-store-compliance. Agent-native interfaces and operations appear in CLI-Anything, OpenSRE, and Firecrawl. AutoClip and diagram-design point to AI-assisted media and creative output, while MiniMind emphasizes hands-on LLM learning. AFFiNE is a privacy-first productivity counterpoint. Languages among the 12 selected repositories: Python 7, TypeScript 2, Shell 2, HTML 1; directional only, not the full Trending page.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's leaders suggest that GitHub attention is clustering around practical ways to give agents repeatable capabilities: specialized skills, software interfaces, research inputs, and guarded operational actions. The breadth of use cases—from security and CI to video and compliance—matters more than any single model trend; the signal is GitHub attention, not proof of product quality or adoption.
